scoring_justification: Task requires DFT computations which the verifier cannot rerun; therefore result-level comparison against paper-derived gold with tolerances is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold lattice parameter a for cI24 at 16 TPa
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.1 and text: a=3.12 Å
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly from the paper's reported optimized lattice parameter

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold enthalpy difference per atom ΔH = H(cI24) - H(oP8)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.2(b) and enthalpy discussion; plan example uses -0.012 eV/atom representing cI24 stability
hidden_assets.generation_method: Estimated from paper's enthalpy curve crossing at 15.5 TPa; plan adopted -0.012 as reference threshold
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Based on the paper's central conclusion that cI24 is more stable than oP8 above 15.5 TPa

hidden_assets.purpose: Minimum phonon frequency of cI24 at 16 TPa (dynamical stability)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.2(c) shows no imaginary modes; phonon frequencies >0 THz
hidden_assets.generation_method: Visual inspection of published phonon dispersion
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Paper explicitly states no imaginary frequencies for cI24

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold electronic band gap of cI24 at 16 TPa
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.4(b) and text: cI24 is metallic, band gap zero
hidden_assets.generation_method: Paper reports metallic behaviour; HSE06 bands cross Fermi level

outputs.description: Optimized lattice parameter a of the cI24 sodium phase at 16 TPa.
Enthalpy difference per atom between cI24 and oP8 at 16 TPa.
Minimum phonon frequency of cI24 at 16 TPa, indicating dynamical stability.
Electronic band gap of cI24 at 16 TPa.

output_contract.notes: All values must be obtained from the same consistent DFT setup and temperature=0 K. The checker compares the reported numbers to the paper's reference results with tolerances that absorb legitimate methodological spread. No further intermediate artifacts are scored.
